Wave 7 (issue #29): assignments WP-40 to WP-50 carry `stage` (0 foundation, 1 parallel features, 2 integrator). An assignment may carry `exclude` (globs inside its write_set that it must not edit, unless an exception names the path) and `lane_exceptions` (photography-lane files it edits through an exception; released by decision W7-9, so nothing waits for WP-12d phase B). scripts/check-ownership.mjs enforces `exclude`; tests/unit/wp-40/write-sets.test.ts proves the stage-1 sets are pairwise disjoint and clear of the frozen paths and the lanes.

Wave 8 (issue #40, docs/wave8-contracts.md): assignments WP-60 to WP-99 carry `stage` (0 foundation, 1 authoring, 2 closing) and `pools` (P0b, P1, P2: the sets of packages that can run at the same time). `frozen_paths_wave8` lists files only the owners in `frozen_paths_wave8_owners` may touch; scripts/check-ownership.mjs reads it. An assignment may carry `exceptions_declared` (frozen files its owner registers an exception for when the work needs it) and `serialize_with_release` (release-lane files it edits and must order by hand with WP-30). tests/unit/wp-60/write-sets-wave8.test.ts proves the pools disjoint and clear of the frozen, wave 8 frozen, photography and release lists.

Wave 8 (issue #40, docs/wave8-contracts.md): assignments WP-60 to WP-99 carry `stage` (0 foundation, 1 authoring, 2 closing) and `pools` (P0b, P1, P2: the sets of packages that can run at the same time). `frozen_paths_wave8` lists files only the owners in `frozen_paths_wave8_owners` (WP-60) may touch; every other owner, WP-99 included, needs a registered exception that names the path. scripts/check-ownership.mjs reads it.
